## Document: docs/topic--05-api-reference.md (API Reference)

# API Reference

[<- Back to 04. Integration Guide](./topic--04-integration-guide.md) | [Back to Main README](../README.md)

---

## Entry Points

| Import path | Re-exports |
|---|---|
| `@actdim/livestruct` | `createLiveStruct` + engine module + lens module + document module (+ deprecated `LiveSqliteEngine`). |
| `@actdim/livestruct/engine` | engine module + document module + lens module (no `createLiveStruct`). |
| `@actdim/livestruct/document` | document module (via the `./*` wildcard export). |
| `@actdim/livestruct/lens` | lens module (via the `./*` wildcard export). |
| `@actdim/livestruct/worker` | Side-effect worker script: `makeWorker({ schema })`. No exports. |
| `@actdim/livestruct/shared-worker` | Side-effect SharedWorker script: imports `@livestore/adapter-web/shared-worker`. No exports. |

Below, symbols are grouped by module. All of them are available from the root import `@actdim/livestruct`.

---

## Store Factory (`src/index.ts`)

| Symbol | Signature | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `createLiveStruct` | `(config: LiveStructConfig) => Promise<LiveStoreInstance>` | Creates engine, overlay channel and commit scheduler; returns the store with collection access, flush and close. |

---

## Document Module (`src/document/`)

### Contracts (`types.ts`)

| Symbol | Kind | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `Disposable` | interface | `dispose(): void`, `readonly isDisposed: boolean`. |
| `PatchPayload<T>` | type | Recursive RFC 7396 patch: optional keys, nested objects partial or `null`, arrays replaced whole, leaves `T[K] \| null`. |
| `CommitPolicy` | type | `'lazy' \| 'immediate'`. |
| `LiveStructEventType` | type | `'local_patch' \| 'overlay_sent' \| 'overlay_received' \| 'commit' \| 'remote_commit'`. |
| `LiveStructEvent` | interface | `type`, `collection`, `id`, `timestamp`, optional `rev`, `overlayId`, `senderSessionId`, `origin`, `patch`. |
| `LiveDocumentOptions` | interface | `commitPolicy?`, `commitDelayMs?`, `maxCommitWaitMs?` - per-collection commit settings. |
| `LiveDocument<T>` | interface | High-level document (members below). |
| `ILiveDocument<T>` | type | Alias of `LiveDocument<T>`. |
| `LiveCollection<T>` | interface | High-level collection (members below). |
| `LiveStructConfig` | interface | Store configuration (fields below). |
| `LiveStoreInstance` | interface | Store returned by `createLiveStruct` (members below). |
| `ObservableLiveDocument<T>` | type | `LiveDocument<T> & T` - result of `toObservableDocument`. |

#### `LiveDocument<T>` members

| Member | Type | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `id`, `collectionName` | `string` | Identity. |
| `data` | `Readonly<T>` | Deeply frozen current snapshot; MobX-tracked read. |
| `$` | `Observable<Readonly<T>>` | Current value plus every verified change. |
| `errors$` | `Observable<Error>` | Deferred commit errors. |
| `events$` | `Observable<LiveStructEvent>` | Store events filtered to this document. |
| `isPending` | `boolean` | Local uncommitted patches exist. |
| `isTentative` | `boolean` | Showing another context's uncommitted overlay. |
| `patch(partial)` | `(partial: PatchPayload<T>) => Promise<void>` | RFC 7396 merge patch; instant locally, resolves when committed. |
| `patchUnchecked(patch)` | `(patch: Record<string, unknown>) => Promise<void>` | Untyped `patch`. |
| `patchPath(path, value)` | `<P extends NestedPath<T>>(path: P, value: PathValue<T, P>) => Promise<void>` | SET at a dot path (committed as `DocPathSet`). |
| `replace(value)` | `(value: T) => Promise<void>` | Replaces the committed body (engine `updateDoc`), pending patches re-applied on top. |
| `flush()` | `() => Promise<void>` | Commits this document's pending patches now. |
| `subscriptionCount` | `number \| undefined` | 1 while the CDC subscription is active, else 0. |
| `engine` | `LiveEngineAccess<T>` | Per-collection low-level access. |
| `dispose()`, `isDisposed` | - | From `Disposable`. |

#### `LiveCollection<T>` members

| Member | Signature | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | Collection name. |
| `subscriptionCount` | `number` | Collection CDC subscription plus document subscriptions. |
| `get(id)` | `(id: string) => Promise<LiveDocument<T> \| null>` | Cached or loaded document; `null` if absent. |
| `create(id, initialData)` | `(id: string, initialData: T) => Promise<LiveDocument<T>>` | Inserts; throws if the id exists. |
| `delete(id)` | `(id: string) => Promise<void>` | Deletes the row and disposes the cached document. |
| `find(predicate?)` | `(predicate?: (item: T) => boolean) => Promise<Array<LiveDocument<T>>>` | All (or matching) documents. |
| `query$` | `Observable<Array<LiveDocument<T>>>` | All documents, refreshed on collection CDC. |
| `errors$` | `Observable<Error>` | Query refresh errors. |
| `flush()` | `() => Promise<void>` | Commits all pending patches of the collection. |
| `dispose()`, `isDisposed` | - | From `Disposable`. |

#### `LiveStructConfig` fields

`name: string`; optional `storagePath`, `forceMemory`, `sessionId`, `disableDevtools`, `confirmUnsavedChanges`, `worker`, `sharedWorker`, `commitPolicy` (default `'lazy'`), `commitDelayMs` (150), `maxCommitWaitMs` (1000), `overlayTtlMs` (1500), `disableOverlay`.

#### `LiveStoreInstance` members

| Member | Signature | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `engine` | `LiveDocEngine` | Low-level engine. |
| `storageMode` | `string` | `'persisted'`, `'single-tab'` or `'in-memory'` (from LiveStore), else storage adapter mode. |
| `errors$` | `Observable<Error>` | Commit scheduler errors. |
| `events$` | `Observable<LiveStructEvent>` | Diagnostic events. |
| `collection(name, options?)` | `<T extends object>(name: string, options?: LiveDocumentOptions) => Promise<LiveCollection<T>>` | Cached collection by name. |
| `flush()` | `() => Promise<void>` | Commits all pending patches. |
| `close()` | `() => Promise<void>` | Flushes, disposes everything and closes the engine. |

### Implementations

| Symbol | Signature | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `LiveDocumentImpl<T>` | `class implements LiveDocument<T>, CommitSchedulerDocumentTarget, OverlayDocumentTarget` | Document implementation; constructed by collections (`(collectionName, id, initialData, initialRev, rawEngine, engineAccess, commitScheduler?, overlayChannel?, options?, onEvent?, allEvents$?)`). |
| `LiveCollectionImpl<T>` | `class implements LiveCollection<T>` | Collection implementation (`(name, rawEngine, commitScheduler?, overlayChannel?, options?, onEvent?, allEvents$?)`). |
| `toObservableDocument` | `<T extends object>(doc: LiveDocument<T>) => ObservableLiveDocument<T>` | Cached Proxy: property reads from `doc.data`, property writes call `patchUnchecked`. |

### Commit scheduling (`commitScheduler.ts`)

| Symbol | Kind | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `CommitSchedulerDocumentTarget` | interface | `onCommitSuccess(newRev, committedData, overlayId, committedPatch)`, `onCommitError(failedPatch, err)`. |
| `CommitSchedulerConfig` | interface | `commitPolicy?`, `commitDelayMs?`, `maxCommitWaitMs?`, `overlayChannel?`, `onEvent?`. |
| `CommitScheduler` | class | `new CommitScheduler(engine: LiveDocEngine, config?)`. |

`CommitScheduler` members: `defaultPolicy`, `defaultDelayMs`, `defaultMaxWaitMs`, `errors$`, `reportError(err)`, `registerDocument(collection, id, doc)`, `unregisterDocument(collection, id)`, `hasPending(collection, id)`, `getPendingPatch(collection, id)`, `getPendingOverlayId(collection, id)`, `schedulePatch(collection, id, patch, blobs?, options?) => { promise, overlayId }`, `schedulePathSet(collection, id, path, value, options?) => { promise, overlayId }`, `commitBatch(docKeys, isFlush?)`, `flushDoc(collection, id)`, `flushCollection(collection)`, `flushAll()`, `dispose()`.

### Overlays (`overlayChannel.ts`)

| Symbol | Kind | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `OverlayMessage` | interface | `{ type: 'overlay', collection, id, patch, overlayId, senderSessionId, timestamp }`. |
| `CommitMessage` | interface | `{ type: 'commit', collection, id, overlayId, patch?, rev?, senderSessionId, timestamp }`. |
| `OverlayChannelMessage` | type | `OverlayMessage \| CommitMessage`. |
| `OverlayDocumentTarget` | interface | `applyRemoteOverlay(patch, overlayId)`, `clearRemoteOverlay(overlayId)`, optional `applyRemoteCommit(patch, rev, overlayId)`. |
| `OverlayChannelOptions` | interface | `storeId`, `sessionId?`, `overlayTtlMs?` (1500), `disabled?`, `onEvent?`. |
| `OverlayChannel` | class | `BroadcastChannel` named `livestruct:<storeId>:overlay`. |

`OverlayChannel` members: `storeId`, `sessionId`, `overlayTtlMs`, `registerDocument(collection, id, doc)`, `unregisterDocument(collection, id)`, `sendTentative(collection, id, patch, overlayId)`, `flushOutgoing()`, `broadcastCommit(collection, id, overlayId, patch?, rev?)`, `dropOverlay(collection, id, overlayId?)`, `dispose()`.

### Helpers

| Symbol | Signature | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `LiveStructValueError` | `class extends Error { readonly path?: string }` | Thrown by `assertJsonSafe`. |
| `ErrorSink` | `{ next(err: Error): void } \| ((err: Error) => void) \| undefined` | Target for `reportAsync`. |
| `reportAsync` | `<T>(promise: Promise<T> \| undefined \| null, context: string, errors$?: ErrorSink) => Promise<T \| undefined>` | Swallows a rejection and routes it to an error sink. |
| `deepFreeze` | `<T>(obj: T) => Readonly<T>` | Recursive `Object.freeze`. |
| `deepEquals` | `(a: unknown, b: unknown) => boolean` | Structural equality (arrays, plain objects, `Uint8Array`, `Float32Array`). |
| `assertJsonSafe` | `(value: unknown, path?: string, seen?: Set<unknown>) => void` | Rejects non-JSON values with `LiveStructValueError`. |
| `toSqliteJsonPath` | `(path: string) => string` | `'items.0.title'` -> `'$.items[0].title'`. |
| `setAtPath` | `<T extends object>(target: T, path: string, value: unknown) => T` | SET at a path on a `structuredClone`. |
| `buildPathPatch` | `<T extends object, P extends NestedPath<T>>(target: T, path: P, value: PathValue<T, P>) => Record<string, unknown>` | Builds a merge patch equivalent to a path write. |

---

## Lens Module (`src/lens/`)

| Symbol | Signature | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `Primitive` | type | `string \| number \| boolean \| bigint \| symbol \| null \| undefined`. |
| `LeafTypes` | type | Types not descended into by `NestedPath` (primitives, `Function`, `Date`, `RegExp`, typed arrays, `ArrayBuffer`, `DataView`, `Blob`, `Map`, `Set`, `WeakMap`, `WeakSet`, `Promise`). |
| `IsLeaf<T>` | type | `true` if `T` is a leaf (or `any`). |
| `DepthCounter` | type | `readonly unknown[]` recursion counter. |
| `DefaultMaxDepth` | type | `4`. |
| `NestedPath<T, Depth?>` | type | Union of all dot paths of `T` up to `DefaultMaxDepth`. |
| `PathValue<T, P>` | type | Value type at path `P`. |
| `PatchPayload<T>` | type | Re-exported from the document types. |
| `getNestedPath` | `<T, P extends NestedPath<T>>(obj: T, path: P) => PathValue<T, P> \| undefined` | Safe read. |
| `hasNestedPath` | `<T>(obj: T, path: string) => boolean` | Own-property / index existence check. |
| `setNestedPath` | `<T, P extends NestedPath<T>>(obj: T, path: P, value: PathValue<T, P>) => T` | Immutable set; creates missing objects or arrays. |
| `deleteNestedPath` | `<T, P extends NestedPath<T>>(obj: T, path: P) => T` | Immutable delete (array items are spliced). |
| `LensDocumentTarget<T>` | interface | `{ readonly data: Readonly<T>; patchPath(path, value): Promise<void> }`. |
| `createDocLens` | `<T extends object, P extends NestedPath<T>>(doc: LensDocumentTarget<T>, path: P) => { path; get(); set(value): Promise<void> }` | Lens bound to a document path; writes go through `patchPath`. |
| `createLens` | same as `createDocLens` | Alias. |

---

## Engine Module (`src/engine/`)

### Types (`types.ts`)

| Symbol | Kind | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `StorageMode` | type | `'opfs' \| 'single-tab' \| 'memory' \| 'persisted' \| 'in-memory'`. |
| `StorageAdapter` | interface | `mode`, `read(path)`, `write(path, data)`, `delete(path)`, `exists(path)`, `close?()`. |
| `BlobMap` | type | `Record<string, Uint8Array \| Float32Array>`. |
| `DocumentRecord<T>` | interface | `collection`, `id`, `rev`, `data`, `blobs`, `updatedAt`. |
| `CDCEventType` | type | `'insert' \| 'update' \| 'delete'`. |
| `CDCEventKind` | type | `CDCEventType \| 'replace'`. |
| `CDCEvent<T>` | interface | `type`, `kind?`, `collection`, `id`, `rev`, `delta`, `data?`, `timestamp`, `mutationId?`, `overlayId?`, `origin?`. |
| `RawCommitEvent<T>` | interface | `type: 'insert' \| 'update' \| 'patch' \| 'delete'`, `collection`, `id`, `data?`, `blobs?`, `rev?`, `mutationId?`, `overlayId?`, `origin?`. |
| `EngineConfig` | interface | `name`, `storagePath?`, `forceMemory?`, `sessionId?`, `disableDevtools?`, `confirmUnsavedChanges?`, `worker?`, `sharedWorker?`. |
| `LiveEngineAccess<T>` | interface | `tableName`, `commitRaw(event)`, `queryRaw<R>(sql, params?)`, `cdc$`. |

### Engine (`liveStoreEngine.ts`)

| Symbol | Signature | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `LiveStoreInstanceLike` | interface | Minimal LiveStore surface used by the engine: `query`, `commit`, `subscribe`, optional `storageMode`, `shutdownPromise`, `isClosed`. |
| `LiveDocEngine` | `class` - `new LiveDocEngine(config: EngineConfig, storeOrStorage?: unknown, blobStore?: BlobStore)` | Document engine over a LiveStore instance. |
| `LiveSqliteEngine` | alias of `LiveDocEngine` | Deprecated name, kept for compatibility. |
| `createLiveEngine` | `(config: EngineConfig) => Promise<LiveDocEngine>` | Resolves adapter and blob store, creates the LiveStore with the built-in schema, initializes the engine. |

`LiveDocEngine` members:

| Member | Signature | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `config`, `store`, `blobStore`, `storage` | properties | Configuration and collaborators. |
| `isClosed`, `storageMode`, `subscriptionCount` | getters | State. |
| `cdc$` | `Observable<CDCEvent<unknown>>` | Full CDC stream (local and remote). |
| `init()` | `() => Promise<this>` | Migrates legacy v1 data, seeds known rows, subscribes to `tables.docs`. |
| `insertDoc` | `<T>(collection, id, data: T, blobs?, mutationId?) => Promise<DocumentRecord<T>>` | `DocInserted`; throws on duplicate id. |
| `updateDoc` | `<T>(collection, id, data: T, blobs?, mutationId?) => Promise<DocumentRecord<T>>` | `DocReplaced` (upsert, full body). |
| `patchDoc` | `<T>(collection, id, patch, blobs?, mutationId?) => Promise<DocumentRecord<T>>` | `DocPatched` (RFC 7396). |
| `setPathDoc` | `<T>(collection, id, path, value, mutationId?) => Promise<DocumentRecord<T>>` | `DocPathSet` (`json_set`). |
| `commitBatchedPatches` | `(entries: Array<{ collection; id; patch?; pathSet?; pathSets?; blobs?; mutationId?; overlayId?; emitCDC? }>) => Promise<DocumentRecord[]>` | Many patches in one `store.commit`. |
| `deleteDoc` | `(collection, id, mutationId?) => Promise<boolean>` | `DocDeleted`; `false` if absent. |
| `getDoc` | `<T>(collection, id) => Promise<DocumentRecord<T> \| null>` | Snapshot with rehydrated blobs. |
| `queryDocs` | `<T>(collection, predicate?: (doc: DocumentRecord<T>) => boolean) => Promise<DocumentRecord<T>[]>` | All rows of a collection (blobs not loaded). |
| `emitCDC` | `(event: CDCEvent<unknown>) => void` | Pushes an event to `cdc$`. |
| `getEngineAccess` | `<T>(collection) => LiveEngineAccess<T>` | Collection-scoped access (used as `doc.engine`). |
| `commitRaw` | `(event: unknown, defaultCollection?) => Promise<void>` | Dispatches a `RawCommitEvent` to insert/update/patch/delete. |
| `queryRaw` | `<R>(sql, params?, defaultCollection?) => Promise<R[]>` | Read-only SQL (`SELECT` / `PRAGMA`); collection names in `FROM` are rewritten to a `docs` subquery. |
| `close()` | `() => Promise<void>` | Completes `cdc$`, writes the legacy JSON snapshot to `storage`, closes blobs, shuts down LiveStore. |

### Schema (`schema.ts`)

| Symbol | Summary |
|---|---|
| `docs` | `State.SQLite.table` `docs`: `key` (PK), `collection`, `id`, `body`, `rev`, `updatedAt`, `blobs`, `mutationId`, `overlayId`, `origin`; index `idx_docs_collection_updatedAt`. |
| `tables` | `{ docs }`. |
| `events` | `DocInserted`, `DocReplaced`, `DocPatched`, `DocPathSet`, `DocDeleted` (names `livestruct.v1.*`, `Events.synced`). |
| `makeDocKey` | `(collection: string, id: string) => string` - `` `${collection}\u0001${id}` ``. |
| `state` | `State.SQLite.makeState({ tables, materializers })`. |
| `schema` | `makeSchema({ state, events })` - pass to `makeWorker({ schema })`. |

### Patching (`patch.ts`)

| Symbol | Signature | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `jsonMergePatch` | `<T>(target: unknown, patch: unknown) => T` | Applies an RFC 7396 merge patch. |
| `mergePatches` | `(basePatch, newPatch) => Record<string, unknown>` | Combines two merge patches, keeping `null` tombstones. |

### Adapters and storage

| Symbol | Signature | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `ResolvedLiveStoreConfig` | interface `{ adapter, sessionId, storageMode: 'persisted' \| 'single-tab' \| 'in-memory' }` | Result of adapter resolution. |
| `resolveLiveStoreAdapter` | `(config: EngineConfig) => ResolvedLiveStoreConfig` | Picks persisted / single-tab / in-memory LiveStore adapter. |
| `MemoryStorageAdapter` | `class implements StorageAdapter` | In-memory file storage (`mode: 'memory'`). |
| `OpfsStorageAdapter` | `class implements StorageAdapter` | OPFS file storage with serialized, retried writes (`mode: 'opfs'`). |
| `resolveStorageAdapter` | `(config: EngineConfig) => Promise<StorageAdapter>` | OPFS when available, else memory. |
| `migrateLegacyV1` | `(config, store: { commit }, blobStore, storageOverride?) => Promise<boolean>` | Imports a v1 `<name>.db` JSON file once and renames it to `.migrated`. |

### Blobs

| Symbol | Signature | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `BlobStore` | interface `put(data) => Promise<string>`, `get(hash)`, `delete?(hash)`, `close?()` | Content-addressed binary store. |
| `MemoryBlobStore` | `class implements BlobStore` | In-memory map. |
| `OpfsBlobStore` | `class implements BlobStore` | OPFS directory `livestruct-blobs/<sha256>` with in-memory fallback. |
| `resolveBlobStore` | `(forceMemory?: boolean) => BlobStore` | OPFS when available and not forced to memory. |
| `serializeBlobs` | `(blobs?: BlobMap \| null) => Uint8Array \| null` | Legacy `LSB1` container format (used by v1 migration). |
| `deserializeBlobs` | `(buffer?: Uint8Array \| null) => BlobMap` | Reads the `LSB1` container format. |

## Document: docs/topic--architecture.md (LiveStruct Architecture & Engine Design)

# LiveStruct Architecture & Engine Design

LiveStruct is an ergonomic, reactive document abstraction built on LiveStore 0.5.0 (SQLite WASM and event-sourcing). Heavy operations (file system I/O, SQLite transaction coordination, cross-tab synchronization) execute in background workers, while the UI thread maintains a lightweight client session with synchronous snapshots.

Related pages: [Architecture & Wiring](./topic--03-architecture-and-wiring.md) (runtime topology, data-flow diagrams), [Domain Model](./topic--domain-model.md) (records, events, document states), [LiveStore Integration](./topic--livestore-integration.md) (spike evidence), [API Reference](./topic--05-api-reference.md).

## 1. System Topology

```text
UI Thread (Tab / Iframe)                                        Background Workers
+-----------------------------------------------+   async   +-------------------------+
| LiveDocument / LiveCollection (Public API)    |  push     | Leader Dedicated Worker |
| - Synchronous snapshot: `doc.data`            | --------> | (@actdim/livestruct/    |
| - Instant RFC 7396 merge: `doc.patch(...)`    |           |  worker):               |
| - Reactive RxJS observable: `doc.$`           |           | - OPFS SQLite writer    |
| - MobX atom integration for fine reactivity   | <-------- | - Eventlog permanence   |
| LiveStore Client Session (SQLite WASM in RAM) |  pull     | - Lock coordination     |
+-----------------------------------------------+           +------------+------------+
                                                                         |
                                                                         | MessagePort
                                                                         v
                                                            +-------------------------+
                                                            | SharedWorker            |
                                                            | (@actdim/livestruct/    |
                                                            |  shared-worker):        |
                                                            | - Cross-context bus     |
                                                            | - Multiplexed sync      |
                                                            +-------------------------+
```

### Key Topology Principles
1. **Single Writer with Web Locks:** A single dedicated worker acts as the elected leader for each database (`storeId`). It alone interacts with browser OPFS (Origin Private File System).
2. **SharedWorker Multiplexing:** Tabs and iframes connect via a SharedWorker to receive background event streams without polling.
3. **Local In-Memory SQLite WASM:** Each UI context maintains an in-memory SQLite mirror that executes sync queries and subscriptions at sub-millisecond latencies.

## 2. Built-in Schema & Materialization

LiveStruct eliminates manual CQRS event boilerplate by providing a universal document schema (`docs` table):

### Table Structure (`docs`)
- `key TEXT PRIMARY KEY`: Composite key `${collection}\x01${id}` ensuring unique records per collection.
- `collection TEXT`: Collection identifier (e.g. `shapes`, `users`).
- `id TEXT`: Document identifier.
- `body TEXT`: Document JSON payload.
- `rev INTEGER`: Monotonically increasing revision number.
- `updatedAt INTEGER`: Deterministic millisecond timestamp.
- `blobs TEXT`: Serialized JSON mapping of blob name to SHA-256 hash.
- `mutationId TEXT`: Unique mutation tracking identifier for echo suppression.
- `overlayId TEXT`: Overlay identifier of the last mutation, used by remote contexts to drop the matching tentative overlay.
- `origin TEXT`: Marker indicating `local`, `remote`, or `migration`.

Index: `idx_docs_collection_updatedAt` on `(collection, updatedAt)`.

### Materializers
- **DocInserted:** Inserts row with `rev = 1`. Duplicate inserts are validated synchronously before commit to prevent corrupting event logs.
- **DocPatched:** Uses SQLite native `json_patch(body, ?)` with positional parameter binding for strict RFC 7396 merge patches (deep nested merges, array replacements, null deletes).
- **DocReplaced:** Performs full document body replacement (`ON CONFLICT (key) DO UPDATE`) with `rev = rev + 1`.
- **DocPathSet:** Uses SQLite `json_set(body, ?, json(?))` with `rev = rev + 1`.
- **DocDeleted:** Deletes row matching `key`.

## 3. Content-Addressed BlobStore

LiveStore event args must remain compact to prevent permanent eventlog bloat. Binary BLOBs (such as `Float32Array` CAD coordinates and `Uint8Array` binary payloads) are handled out-of-band:

1. **Storage:** Blobs are written to a dedicated content-addressed store:
   - In browser: OPFS directory `livestruct-blobs/<sha256>`.
   - In Node/testing: In-memory hash map.
2. **Type Preservation:** Payload bytes are prefixed with a 1-byte header (`0x01` for `Uint8Array`, `0x02` for `Float32Array`) before computing the SHA-256 hash.
3. **Event Payloads:** Event arguments carry only the 64-character SHA-256 hex string.
4. **Rehydration:** On `getDoc()`, binary buffers are retrieved from the BlobStore and rehydrated as exact typed array instances.

## 4. Dual-Level API

### High-Level API (UI & Dynstruct Forms)
- `LiveDocument<T>`: Implements `data` (frozen snapshot), `$` (RxJS observable), `patch(partial)`, `patchUnchecked(patch)`, `patchPath(path, value)`, `replace(value)`, `flush()`, `isPending` / `isTentative`, `errors$` / `events$`, and MobX atom notifications (`toObservableDocument(doc)` adds a property-style Proxy).
- `LiveCollection<T>`: Manages document lifecycle (`get`, `create`, `delete`, `find`, `query$`, `flush`).

### Low-Level Engine API (Worker Bridges & MsgMesh)
- Accessible via `doc.engine` or `store.engine`.
- `queryRaw(sql, params)`: Executes read-only `SELECT` (and `PRAGMA`) queries directly against SQLite. Automatically rewrites queries targeting collection names to subqueries against the `docs` table (exposing `id`, `collection`, `rev`, `data`, `doc_data`, `blobs`, `updated_at`). Any other statement is rejected.
- `commitRaw(event)`: Dispatches raw commit events to engine mutations.
- `cdc$`: Change Data Capture stream. `store.engine.cdc$` emits full `CDCEvent` objects (`type`, `kind`, `collection`, `id`, `rev`, `delta`, `data`, `timestamp`, `mutationId`, `overlayId`, `origin`); the collection-scoped `doc.engine.cdc$` emits `type`, `id`, `delta` and, when present, `mutationId` / `overlayId`.

## 5. Session Isolation & Embedding Defaults

- **Unique Session ID:** Same-origin iframes share `window.sessionStorage`. To prevent session collisions, each context generates an explicit unique `sessionId`.
- **Disabled DevTools by Default:** DevTools communication overhead is disabled unless explicitly requested.
- **Disabled Unsaved Changes Dialog:** `confirmUnsavedChanges: false` prevents LiveStore from registering invasive `beforeunload` prompts on the host page.

## 6. Legacy v1 Migration

Existing v1 JSON databases (`<name>.db`) are automatically detected on first launch:
1. All documents and associated `.blobs.*` binary files are parsed.
2. Binary blobs are stored in the content-addressed BlobStore.
3. Documents are batch-committed to LiveStore with `origin: 'migration'`.
4. The legacy file is renamed to `<name>.db.migrated`, ensuring migration runs exactly once.

## 7. Working with High-Frequency Updates (Transparent Lazy Commits & Overlays)

LiveStore commits are synchronous on the UI thread and append permanent entries to the eventlog. High-frequency mutations (such as 60-120 Hz drag operations, canvas transformations, or slider dragging) cannot commit to SQLite on every tick without freezing the frame or bloating storage.

LiveStruct solves this transparently through an in-memory view layer, coalescing commit scheduler, and lightweight overlay broadcast channel:

### 7.1 Instant Local Updates (Plain Object Feel)
- Calling `doc.patch(...)` or `doc.patchPath(...)` updates `doc.data` immediately and synchronously.
- Local subscriptions (`doc.$`) and MobX atoms fire synchronously in the current microtask.
- Local Change Data Capture (`doc.engine.cdc$`) emits immediately with `origin: 'local'`.
- There is NO synchronous `store.commit` in the `doc.patch` call stack (O(1) execution time, sub-millisecond p99 latency).

### 7.2 Coalesced CommitScheduler
- Pending patches for a document are coalesced into a single RFC 7396 patch using structural sharing and preserving null tombstones.
- Commit timing is controlled by two timers:
  - Trailing debounce window: `commitDelayMs` (default: 150 ms).
  - Upper bounded wait deadline: `maxCommitWaitMs` (default: 1000 ms).
- When multiple documents become due in the same tick, they are committed to SQLite in a single transaction (`commitBatchedPatches`).
- Configuration: Set globally via `createLiveStruct({ commitPolicy: 'lazy', commitDelayMs: 150, maxCommitWaitMs: 1000 })` or per document via `collection.get(id, { commitPolicy: 'immediate' })`.

### 7.3 Flush Semantics and Lifecycle Integration
- Manual flushing: `doc.flush()`, `collection.flush()`, or `store.flush()` commits all pending patches synchronously and resolves after the commit is written to SQLite.
- Automatic flushing: Store instances register listeners on `pagehide` and `visibilitychange` (state `hidden`) to flush all dirty documents before context tear-down.
- Graceful shutdown: `store.close()` flushes all pending mutations before terminating workers.
- Promise lifecycle: The Promise returned by `doc.patch(...)` resolves only when the patch is durably committed to SQLite. Callers that do not await are never blocked.

### 7.4 Live Real-Time Overlays (Cross-Context Tentative Updates)
- High-frequency mutations are shared across same-origin contexts (tabs, iframes) via `OverlayChannel` over a shared BroadcastChannel (`livestruct:<storeId>:overlay`).
- Frame coalescing: The sender throttles transmissions to at most one message per document per animation frame (~16 ms, using `requestAnimationFrame` with fallback to 16 ms timer).
- Receiver state: Remote contexts apply the tentative patch to their in-memory document view without touching SQLite, marking `doc.isTentative === true`.
- Zero persistence: Overlays never touch SQLite or the permanent eventlog.
- Automatic cleanup: Tentative overlays are dropped immediately when a matching commit arrives (tracked by unique `overlayId`) or when `overlayTtlMs` (default: 1500 ms) expires.

### 7.5 CDC Rebase and Notification Suppression
- When a remote commit arrives from LiveStore, LiveStruct computes:
  `view = remoteCommitted + localPendingPatches`
- If the rebased view is structurally identical to the previous view (`deepEquals`), subscriber notifications are suppressed, preventing redundant DOM re-renders.

### 7.6 Error Recovery and Rollback
- If a deferred commit fails (e.g. SQLite validation failure or shutdown abort), affected pending patches are rolled back to the last committed state.
- Associated pending Promises reject, and errors are dispatched to `doc.errors$` and `store.errors$`.

## Document: docs/topic--demo-architecture.md (Demo: System Architecture & Flow)

# @actdim/livestruct-demo Architecture

> The demo app lives in [`demo/`](../demo/README.md) of this repository; file paths in this article are relative to `demo/`.

## 1. System Overview

`@actdim/livestruct-demo` is a Vite + React 19 single-page app deployed to GitHub Pages at [https://actdim.github.io/livestruct/demo/](https://actdim.github.io/livestruct/demo/). It showcases `@actdim/livestruct` living documents on top of LiveStore (SQLite in OPFS, run in a dedicated worker plus a shared worker) and a typed `@actdim/msgmesh` bus. One CAD document (`doc-default` in collection `cad_documents`) is edited from a 2D canvas and a property inspector; a telemetry monitor shows which changes stay in RAM and which reach SQLite.

The libraries themselves are documented on their own sites; this topic only covers how the demo wires them:

- livestruct docs: [https://actdim.github.io/livestruct/](https://actdim.github.io/livestruct/)
- livestruct live demo: [https://actdim.github.io/livestruct/demo/](https://actdim.github.io/livestruct/demo/)
- msgmesh-store: [https://actdim.github.io/msgmesh-store/](https://actdim.github.io/msgmesh-store/)

```text
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|  App.tsx (query params: spike / viewport / split)                             |
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|  Zone 1: VectorCanvas        |  Zone 2: PropertyInspector (MobX observer)     |
|  pointer drag -> doc.patch   |  field edits -> CadStore.updateShapeProperties |
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|  SplitSimulator: single | dual iframe (?viewport=A/B) | native tab            |
|  undo/redo hotkeys, export (.cad download), import (file picker / drop)       |
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|  Zone 3: TelemetryMonitor: liveStore.events$ + bus channel cad.cursor.drag    |
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|  cad/store.ts  CadStore = LiveStoreInstance + LiveCollection + LiveDocument   |
|                + MsgBus<CadMsgStruct> + undo/redo snapshot stacks             |
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|  @actdim/livestruct  (commit scheduler, BroadcastChannel overlay channel)     |
|  LiveStore adapter-web: livestore/worker.ts + shared worker -> SQLite (OPFS)  |
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

## 2. Core Components

| Component | File | Responsibility |
|---|---|---|
| `App` | `src/App.tsx` | Reads `spike`, `viewport`, `split` query params, creates one `CadStore` per browsing context, exposes it as `window.__cadStore`, renders the host shell or a child viewport. |
| `CadStore` / `initCadStore` | `src/cad/store.ts` | Creates the LiveStruct store (`name: 'cad_store'`, unique `sessionId` per context), the `cad_documents` collection and the `doc-default` document seeded with `DEFAULT_SHAPES`; counts `commit`, `overlay_sent`, `overlay_received`, `local_patch` events; keeps undo/redo stacks. |
| LiveStore worker | `src/livestore/worker.ts` | `makeWorker({ schema })` with the schema exported by `@actdim/livestruct/engine`; loaded through Vite's `?worker` import. |
| Shared worker | `@livestore/adapter-web/shared-worker?sharedworker` | Coordinates the OPFS leader across tabs and iframes of the same origin. |
| `VectorCanvas` | `src/components/VectorCanvas.tsx` | Canvas 2D rendering (`cad/renderer.ts`), hit testing and translation (`cad/geometry.ts`), redraw on `doc.$` via `requestAnimationFrame`, ghost rendering while `doc.isTentative`. |
| `PropertyInspector` | `src/components/PropertyInspector.tsx` | MobX `observer` form for the selected shape (name, layer, fill, stroke, stroke width, rotation, bounding box); the name input is buffered and debounced by 200 ms. |
| `SplitSimulator` | `src/components/SplitSimulator.tsx` | Viewport modes, Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y / Ctrl+Shift+Z hotkeys, export and import of `.cad` files. |
| `TelemetryMonitor` | `src/components/TelemetryMonitor.tsx` | Classifies events into `ephemeral`, `sqlite`, `cdc`; throughput, disk-write and per-category counters; channel filters; simulation buttons. |
| Telemetry helpers | `src/telemetry/types.ts` | `calculateThroughput`, `filterTelemetryEvents`, `extractUpdatedFields`, `calculatePayloadSize`. |
| Export / import | `src/cad/exportImport.ts` | Hand-built two-page SQLite 3 file (`cad_documents(id, title, data)`) and a parser that also accepts JSON payloads. |
| LiveStore spike | `src/components/LiveStoreSpikeHarness.tsx`, `src/livestore/schema.ts` | Raw LiveStore benchmark (`?spike=livestore`): host plus two iframes on `storeId: 'spike-livestore-cad'`, 100-commit latency run. |

### 2.1. Entry modes

| URL | Renders |
|---|---|
| `/` | Host shell: `SplitSimulator` in `single` mode plus `TelemetryMonitor`. |
| `/?split=dual` | Host shell starting in dual iframe mode. |
| `/?viewport=A`, `/?viewport=B` | Child viewport (canvas + inspector + undo/redo buttons) used inside the dual iframes. |
| `/?viewport=native` | Same child viewport opened in a real browser tab by the "native tab" mode. |
| `/?spike=livestore` | `LiveStoreSpikeHarness` instead of the CAD app. |

## 3. Data Flow

### 3.1. RAM streaming vs SQLite commits

A canvas drag never writes to SQLite per pointer event. `VectorCanvas` calls `store.doc.patch()` on every `pointermove`; livestruct applies the patch in memory, broadcasts it as a tentative overlay and coalesces it in its commit scheduler. `pointerup` calls `doc.flush()`, which commits the pending patch. The test suite pins this: 300 scripted moves at 8 ms intervals produce at most 4 commits.

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant U as Pointer
    participant C as VectorCanvas
    participant D as LiveDocument (doc-default)
    participant O as Overlay channel (BroadcastChannel)
    participant W as LiveStore worker (SQLite OPFS)
    U->>C: pointermove (60 fps)
    C->>D: doc.patch({ shapes: { id: { x, y } } })
    D-->>C: doc.$ emits (redraw on next frame)
    D->>O: tentative overlay (overlay_sent)
    U->>C: pointerup
    C->>D: doc.flush()
    D->>W: one committed patch (commit event)
    W-->>O: remote_commit to peers, overlays dropped
```

Inspector edits, selection changes, undo/redo and import go through `CadStore` methods or helpers that call `doc.patch()` followed by `await doc.flush()`, so each is one commit.

The msgmesh bus (`createMsgBus<CadMsgStruct>()`) carries the typed channel `cad.cursor.drag`. The monitor subscribes to it and classifies its messages as RAM traffic; the canvas itself drives drags through `doc.patch`, so this channel is an integration point for code that publishes drag streams, not the drag path.

### 3.2. Worker and shared-worker topology

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    subgraph TabOrIframe["Each tab / iframe (own JS heap)"]
        APP["App + CadStore"]
        LS["@actdim/livestruct store (sessionId per context)"]
        APP --> LS
    end
    LS -->|"?worker import"| DW["Dedicated worker: src/livestore/worker.ts"]
    LS -->|"?sharedworker import"| SW["Shared worker: @livestore/adapter-web"]
    DW --> DB[("SQLite in OPFS")]
    SW --- DW
    LS <-->|"livestruct:storeId:overlay"| BC(("BroadcastChannel"))
```

`initCadStore` imports both workers only in a browser and only when `forceMemory` is false. In Node (Vitest) `forceMemory` defaults to true and the store runs in memory; if the worker imports fail, `createLiveStruct` receives no workers.

### 3.3. Multi-tab sync

Every context (host, iframe A, iframe B, native tab) creates its own `CadStore` with a distinct `sessionId` (`session_<senderId>_<time>_<random>`) against the same store name. Peers receive tentative overlays first (the canvas renders ghost shapes and shows "Tentative Remote Overlay"), then the committed change, which livestruct reports as `remote_commit` and the monitor lists as `cdc.replica`. The dual iframes use `sandbox='allow-scripts allow-same-origin allow-forms'`, so they share the origin, OPFS and BroadcastChannel but no in-memory state.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A["Viewport A: doc.patch + flush"] --> SQL[("Shared SQLite (OPFS)")]
    A -.->|tentative overlay| B["Viewport B: ghost render"]
    SQL -->|remote_commit| B2["Viewport B: doc.$ emits committed data"]
    SQL -->|remote_commit| H["Host shell / native tab"]
```

### 3.4. Undo/redo

`CadStore` keeps per-context snapshot stacks. `commitShapeTransform` and `updateShapeProperties` push a deep copy of `doc.data` (stack capped at 50) and clear the redo stack; `selectShape` does not. `undo` / `redo` swap snapshots and call `applySnapshot`, which builds a patch that sets `title`, `selectedShapeId` and every shape of the target, and sets shapes missing from the target to `null`. Because the result is an ordinary committed patch, it replicates to other viewports like any edit; the stacks themselves stay local to the context that made the edits. Canvas drags patch the document directly and do not push undo snapshots.

### 3.5. Export and import

- **Export** (`exportCadDatabase`, `downloadCadProject`): serializes the current `doc.data` into a two-page SQLite 3 file built byte by byte (`CREATE TABLE cad_documents (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT, data TEXT)`, one row whose `data` column is the document JSON; 4096-byte pages, 65536 when the row does not fit). It is downloaded as `project.cad` with type `application/x-sqlite3`. It does not copy the LiveStore OPFS database file.
- **Import** (`parseCadDatabase`, `importCadDatabase`): accepts that SQLite layout (with a JSON scan fallback), a LiveStruct JSON export (`documents["cad_documents:doc-default"].data`) or a raw `CadDocument` JSON. The parsed document is applied as one replacing patch plus `flush`, so all peers update; unknown formats throw `Unsupported or corrupted CAD project format.`

## 4. Invariants

1. **One store per browsing context**: `App` creates and closes the `CadStore` in an effect keyed by `viewport`; disposal closes the LiveStruct store and the events subscription.
2. **Drags commit once**: pointer moves only `doc.patch`; `pointerup` flushes. No component writes SQLite per frame.
3. **Every inspector, undo/redo and import edit is a committed patch**: these paths end with `await doc.flush()`.
4. **Peers sync only through the store**: iframes and tabs exchange data via OPFS/LiveStore and the livestruct overlay channel, never through `postMessage` (the spike harness uses `postMessage` only for benchmark reporting).
5. **Node tests stay in memory**: `forceMemory` defaults to true outside a browser; no worker or OPFS is touched by Vitest.
6. **Library behaviour lives in the libraries**: commit timing, overlay TTL and echo handling are livestruct settings; the demo does not reimplement them.
7. **Deployment path is configurable**: `vite.config.ts` uses `base: process.env.DEMO_BASE || '/'`; links inside the app are relative (`?viewport=A`) so they work under `/livestruct/demo/`.

## 5. Cross-Links

- [Domain Model](./topic--demo-domain-model.md): shape and document model, channels, schemas, telemetry records.
- [Setup & Workflow](./topic--demo-setup-and-workflow.md): commands, tests, browser requirements, Pages CI.
- [README](../demo/README.md): scenarios and zone layout.

## Document: docs/topic--demo-domain-model.md (Demo: Domain Model & Entity Ecosystem)

# @actdim/livestruct-demo Domain Model

> The demo app lives in [`demo/`](../demo/README.md) of this repository; file paths in this article are relative to `demo/`.

## 1. Entity Taxonomy

| Entity | Defined in | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `CadShape` | `src/cad/types.ts` | One drawing primitive: `rect`, `circle` or `line`. |
| `CadDocument` | `src/cad/types.ts` | The edited document: title, selection and a map of shapes. Stored as a LiveStruct document. |
| `CadStore` | `src/cad/store.ts` | Per-context facade: LiveStruct store, `cad_documents` collection, `doc-default` document, msgmesh bus, counters, undo/redo stacks. |
| `CursorDragPayload` | `src/cad/types.ts` | Message payload of the bus channel `cad.cursor.drag`. |
| `TelemetryEvent` | `src/telemetry/types.ts` | One row of the protocol monitor. |
| `TelemetryMetrics` | `src/telemetry/types.ts` | Aggregates shown in the monitor's metrics bar. |
| `.cad` project file | `src/cad/exportImport.ts` | Portable SQLite 3 file with one `cad_documents` row. |
| `docs` row (spike) | `src/livestore/schema.ts` | Raw LiveStore table used only by the `?spike=livestore` harness. |
| `BoundingBox`, `TransformHandle` | `src/cad/types.ts` | Derived geometry for hit testing and selection rendering (`src/cad/geometry.ts`). |

## 2. Front-matter Schemas

The demo has no Markdown entities of its own; its "records" are TypeScript and storage schemas.

### 2.1. CAD shape

```typescript
export type CadShapeType = 'rect' | 'circle' | 'line';

export interface CadShape {
    id: string;
    type: CadShapeType;
    x: number;
    y: number;
    width?: number;   // rect
    height?: number;  // rect
    radius?: number;  // circle
    x2?: number;      // line end
    y2?: number;      // line end
    name?: string;
    layer?: string;   // inspector default: 'geometry'
    fill?: string;
    stroke?: string;
    strokeWidth?: number;
    rotation?: number;
}
```

### 2.2. CAD document

```typescript
export interface CadDocument {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    selectedShapeId?: string | null;
    shapes: Record<string, CadShape>;
    activeLayer?: string;
    metadata?: Record<string, unknown>;
}
```

`initCadStore` creates the document once per store if it is missing:

| Field | Seed value |
|---|---|
| collection | `cad_documents` |
| document id | `doc-default` |
| `title` | `Mechanical Assembly` |
| `selectedShapeId` | `rect-1` |
| `shapes` | `DEFAULT_SHAPES` or `options.initialShapes` |

`DEFAULT_SHAPES`:

| id | type | name | geometry |
|---|---|---|---|
| `rect-1` | `rect` | Main Bracket | x 60, y 60, 140 x 90 |
| `circle-1` | `circle` | Bearing Mount | x 320, y 120, radius 45 |
| `line-1` | `line` | Center Axis | (60, 240) -> (360, 240) |

All mutations are partial deep patches of `CadDocument`; a shape key set to `null` removes that shape (used by undo/redo and import).

### 2.3. Bus channels and payloads

The bus is `createMsgBus<CadMsgStruct>()` from `@actdim/msgmesh/core` (or `options.bus`).

```typescript
export interface CursorDragPayload {
    shapeId: string;
    x: number;
    y: number;
    dx: number;
    dy: number;
    timestamp: number;
    senderId?: string;
}

export type CadMsgStruct = {
    'cad.cursor.drag': { in: CursorDragPayload };
};

export const CAD_DRAG_CHANNEL = 'cad.cursor.drag' as const;
```

`TelemetryMonitor` listens on `CAD_DRAG_CHANNEL` with an abort signal and records each message as an `ephemeral` event, computing latency from `payload.timestamp`. Channel semantics (groups, request/response) are described on the msgmesh and msgmesh-store sites ([https://actdim.github.io/msgmesh-store/](https://actdim.github.io/msgmesh-store/)).

### 2.4. LiveStore schema usage

- **CAD app**: `src/livestore/worker.ts` runs `makeWorker({ schema })` with the schema from `@actdim/livestruct/engine`. The demo does not define tables for the CAD document; it uses the LiveStruct collection API (`liveStore.collection<CadDocument>('cad_documents')`, `collection.get`, `collection.create`, `doc.patch`, `doc.flush`, `doc.$`, `doc.isTentative`). Storage layout is described at [https://actdim.github.io/livestruct/](https://actdim.github.io/livestruct/).
- **Spike harness**: `src/livestore/schema.ts` defines a standalone LiveStore schema used with `makePersistedAdapter` and `storeId: 'spike-livestore-cad'`:

| Element | Definition |
|---|---|
| table `docs` | `id` text primary key, `body` text JSON (default `{}`), `mutation_id` text, `origin` text |
| event `doc.created` | `{ id, body, mutationId, origin }` -> insert row |
| event `doc.patched` | `{ id, patch, mutationId, origin }` -> `UPDATE docs SET body = json_patch(body, ?) ...` |
| event `doc.deleted` | `{ id, mutationId, origin }` -> delete row |

### 2.5. `.cad` project file

```sql
CREATE TABLE cad_documents (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT, data TEXT)
```

One row: `id` = document id (default `doc-default`), `title`, `data` = `JSON.stringify(CadDocument)`. Import also accepts `{ "documents": { "cad_documents:doc-default": { "data": CadDocument } } }` and a bare `CadDocument` JSON object.

### 2.6. Telemetry messages

```typescript
export type TelemetryCategory = 'ephemeral' | 'sqlite' | 'cdc';

export interface TelemetryEvent {
    id: string;
    timestamp: number;
    category: TelemetryCategory;
    channel: string;
    latencyUs?: number;
    sizeBytes?: number;
    updatedFields?: string[];
    rev?: number;
    origin?: string;
    payloadSummary: string;
    rawPayload?: unknown;
}
```

Mapping from sources to monitor rows:

| Source | Channel | Category | Badge |
|---|---|---|---|
| LiveStruct `local_patch` | `livestruct.patch` | `ephemeral` | RAM |
| LiveStruct `overlay_sent` | `livestruct.overlay.sent` | `ephemeral` | RAM |
| LiveStruct `overlay_received` | `livestruct.overlay.received` | `cdc` | CDC |
| LiveStruct `commit` | `sqlite.commit` | `sqlite` | SQLITE COMMIT (with `rev`, size, fields) |
| LiveStruct `remote_commit` | `cdc.replica` | `cdc` | CDC REPLICA (with origin) |
| Bus `cad.cursor.drag` | `cad.cursor.drag` | `ephemeral` | RAM |
| "Simulate CDC" button | `cdc.replica` (origin `tab-2`) | `cdc` | CDC REPLICA |

`updatedFields` are leaf dot paths from `extractUpdatedFields(patch)` (for example `shapes.rect-1.x`); `sizeBytes` is the UTF-8 JSON size from `calculatePayloadSize`. `TelemetryMetrics` holds `messagesPerSec` (rolling 1 s window from `calculateThroughput`), `diskWriteCount` (from `CadStore.diskCommitCount` when a store exists), and per-category totals. Filters accept `ALL`, `cad.*`, `sqlite.*`, `cdc.*` or free text matched against channel, category, payload summary, origin and fields.

## 3. Graph Relationships

```mermaid
erDiagram
    CadStore ||--|| LiveStoreInstance : wraps
    CadStore ||--|| MsgBus : owns
    LiveStoreInstance ||--o{ LiveCollection : "collection('cad_documents')"
    LiveCollection ||--|| CadDocument : "doc-default"
    CadDocument ||--o{ CadShape : "shapes[id]"
    CadShape ||--|| BoundingBox : "getBoundingBox"
    MsgBus ||--o{ CursorDragPayload : "cad.cursor.drag"
    LiveStoreInstance ||--o{ TelemetryEvent : "events$ mapped"
    MsgBus ||--o{ TelemetryEvent : "drag messages mapped"
    CadDocument ||--|| CadProjectFile : "export / import"
```

- `CadDocument.selectedShapeId` references a key of `CadDocument.shapes` or is `null`.
- Each browsing context owns one `CadStore`; all contexts of one origin share the persisted `cad_documents/doc-default` through LiveStore.
- Undo/redo stacks hold whole `CadDocument` snapshots and are not persisted.

## 4. Cross-Links

- [Architecture](./topic--demo-architecture.md): data flow, worker topology, invariants.
- [Setup & Workflow](./topic--demo-setup-and-workflow.md): commands and tests that exercise these models.

## Document: docs/topic--demo-setup-and-workflow.md (Demo: Setup, Build & Workflow)

# @actdim/livestruct-demo Setup, Build & Workflow

> The demo app lives in [`demo/`](../demo/README.md) of this repository; file paths in this article are relative to `demo/`.

## 1. Prerequisites

- **Node.js**: 22 (the version the Pages workflow uses).
- **Package manager**: `pnpm` (CI pins 10.30.3).
- **Workspace**: the demo lives in `demo/` of the livestruct repository. It depends on `@actdim/livestruct` as `workspace:*`, declares `catalog:` versions for `@livestore/livestore`, `@livestore/adapter-web`, `@livestore/wa-sqlite` and `effect`, and `>=1.12.0` ranges for `@actdim/msgmesh` and `@actdim/utico`. It installs inside a pnpm workspace that provides that catalog: the livestruct repository root (`pnpm-workspace.yaml` with packages `.` and `demo`, the other `@actdim` packages from npm) or the mempart monorepo (`src/pnpm-workspace.yaml` lists `packages/livestruct/demo`, all `@actdim` packages from their folders).
- **Browser** (persistent mode): a secure context (`localhost` or HTTPS) with OPFS (`navigator.storage.getDirectory`), module `Worker`, `SharedWorker` and `BroadcastChannel`. A browser without `SharedWorker` cannot run the persisted multi-tab setup. Same-origin iframes need storage access, so private or third-party-cookie-restricted modes can block the dual view.

## 2. Running Inside mempart

The demo is the folder `src/packages/livestruct/demo` (inside the livestruct submodule) and a member of the mempart pnpm workspace; the nested `pnpm-workspace.yaml` of livestruct is ignored there. mempart's `src/package.json` has `dev:demo` / `build:demo` shortcuts only for `@actdim/dynstruct-demo`, so address this package with a filter from `src/`:

```bash
cd src
pnpm install
pnpm --filter @actdim/livestruct-demo dev     # Vite dev server on http://localhost:4173
pnpm --filter @actdim/livestruct-demo build
pnpm --filter @actdim/livestruct-demo test
```

The workspace links `@actdim/livestruct`, `msgmesh` and `utico` from their sibling folders (the demo does not depend on `dynstruct` or `msgmesh-store`). Their `exports` point at `dist/`, so build a library (`pnpm --filter @actdim/livestruct build`) after changing it before the demo sees the change.

Useful URLs on the dev server: `/` (host shell), `/?split=dual` (two isolated iframes), `/?viewport=A` (single child viewport), `/?spike=livestore` (raw LiveStore benchmark). In the browser console `window.__cadStore` is the active `CadStore`.

## 3. Runner Commands

Run from the package folder (or with `pnpm --filter @actdim/livestruct-demo <script>` from mempart `src/`).

| Command | Action | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `pnpm run dev` | `vite` | Dev server on port 4173 with the dedicated LiveStore worker and shared worker. |
| `pnpm run build` | `tsc -b tsconfig.json && vite build` | Typechecks, then bundles the SPA into `dist/` (base path from `DEMO_BASE`, default `/`). |
| `pnpm run preview` | `vite preview` | Serves the built `dist/`. |
| `pnpm run test` | `npx vitest --config=vitest.node.config.ts --no-cache` | Runs `tests/**/*.test.ts` once in Node. |
| `pnpm run typecheck` | `tsc -b tsconfig.json` | Type checks without bundling. |
| `pnpm run format` | `prettier --write .` | Formats the package. |
| `pnpm run format:check` | `prettier --check .` | Verifies formatting. |

## 4. Tests

`vitest.node.config.ts` runs in the `node` environment with globals, `pool: 'forks'`, `isolate: false`, setup file `vitest.setup.ts` (defines `globalThis.self`) and typecheck config `tsconfig.dev.json`. In Node `initCadStore` defaults to `forceMemory`, so no OPFS or worker is used.

| File | Covers |
|---|---|
| `tests/vectorCanvas.test.ts` | Geometry (bounding boxes, hit testing, translation, handles), drag patches without synchronous writes, one commit on flush, 300-move drag benchmark with at most 4 commits, reaction to external `doc.$` updates, renderer routines. |
| `tests/propertyInspector.test.ts` | MobX observer rendering, per-field patch commits, canvas-to-inspector sync, shape selector, 200 ms name debounce and flush. |
| `tests/splitSimulator.test.ts` | Cross-viewport overlays and commits, echo suppression, mode switching and iframe sandbox, undo/redo replication, `.cad` export as valid SQLite, import of SQLite and JSON payloads with peer propagation. |
| `tests/telemetryMonitor.test.ts` | Badges per category, throughput metrics, channel and text filters, field and size extraction, live `CadStore` event capture, simulation controls. |

## 5. GitHub Pages CI

The livestruct repository workflow `.github/workflows/pages.yml` publishes one site: the docs at [https://actdim.github.io/livestruct/](https://actdim.github.io/livestruct/) and the demo at [https://actdim.github.io/livestruct/demo/](https://actdim.github.io/livestruct/demo/). It runs on push to `main` (docs, `src/`, `demo/`, `pnpm-workspace.yaml`, the workflow) and on manual dispatch.

After the docs build, the `Build demo` step (with `DEMO_BASE=<base_path>/demo/`):

1. Runs `pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile` in the repository workspace (`.` and `demo`; the catalog lives in `pnpm-workspace.yaml`).
2. Builds the library (`pnpm run build`), because the demo imports `@actdim/livestruct` through its `dist/` exports.
3. Builds the demo (`pnpm --filter @actdim/livestruct-demo build`) and copies `demo/dist` to `.dist-docs/demo`.

`@actdim/msgmesh` and `@actdim/utico` come from npm. Until they are published at `>=1.12.0` the step fails; it is `continue-on-error`, so the docs still deploy without the demo.

### 5.1. Local reproduction

From the livestruct repository root (bash, outside mempart):

```bash
pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile
pnpm run build
DEMO_BASE=/livestruct/demo/ pnpm --filter @actdim/livestruct-demo build
pnpm --filter @actdim/livestruct-demo preview -- --base /livestruct/demo/
```

PowerShell:

```powershell
$env:DEMO_BASE = '/livestruct/demo/'; pnpm --filter @actdim/livestruct-demo build
```

## 6. Quality Gates

1. `pnpm run typecheck` and `pnpm run test` pass.
2. `pnpm run format:check` is clean.
3. `pnpm run build` succeeds with and without `DEMO_BASE`; relative links (`?viewport=A`) keep working under `/livestruct/demo/`.
4. A manual check in a browser with OPFS: drag a shape in `/?split=dual`, confirm the peer shows the tentative ghost and then the committed position, and that the monitor shows one `sqlite.commit` per drag.
5. Docs stay ASCII, with fenced code languages and relative links (checked at commit time in the livestruct repository).
6. Versioning: the package version follows the mempart monorepo. Change it only with `pnpm run version:sync <version>` from mempart `src/`, never by editing this `package.json` alone.

## Document: docs/topic--domain-model.md (Domain Model & Entity Ecosystem)

# Domain Model & Entity Ecosystem

Core technical specification of the entities, records and event contracts that `@actdim/livestruct` manages. For usage see [Core Concepts](./topic--02-core-concepts.md); for the full symbol list see [API Reference](./topic--05-api-reference.md).

## 1. Entity Overview

```mermaid
erDiagram
    STORE ||--o{ COLLECTION : "collection(name)"
    COLLECTION ||--o{ DOCUMENT : "get / create / find"
    DOCUMENT ||--|| DOCS_ROW : "persisted as"
    DOCS_ROW ||--o{ BLOB : "blobs name -> sha256"
    DOCS_ROW ||--o{ LIVESTORE_EVENT : "materialized from"
    DOCUMENT ||--o{ CDC_EVENT : "observes"
    STORE ||--o{ LIVESTRUCT_EVENT : "events$"
```

| Entity | Type | Identity | Lifetime |
|---|---|---|---|
| Store | `LiveStoreInstance` | `LiveStructConfig.name` (LiveStore `storeId`) + `sessionId` | `createLiveStruct()` until `close()` |
| Collection | `LiveCollection<T>` | collection name | cached per store until `dispose()` |
| Document | `LiveDocument<T>` | `(collection, id)` | cached per collection until deleted or disposed |
| Persisted row | `docs` table row / `DocumentRecord<T>` | `key = makeDocKey(collection, id)` | until `DocDeleted` |
| Blob | `Uint8Array` / `Float32Array` in a `BlobStore` | SHA-256 hex of tag byte + bytes | content-addressed, shared by identical payloads |

## 2. Persisted Record (`docs` table)

All collections share one table defined in `src/engine/schema.ts`:

| Column | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `key` | TEXT, primary key | `` `${collection}\u0001${id}` `` |
| `collection` | TEXT | Collection name. |
| `id` | TEXT | Document id within the collection. |
| `body` | TEXT, default `'{}'` | JSON document body. |
| `rev` | INTEGER, default 1 | Revision; incremented by every replace, patch and path set. |
| `updatedAt` | INTEGER | Millisecond timestamp carried by the event. |
| `blobs` | TEXT, default `'{}'` | JSON map of blob name to SHA-256 hash. |
| `mutationId` | TEXT | Id of the last mutation (echo suppression). |
| `overlayId` | TEXT | Overlay id of the last mutation (tentative overlay matching). |
| `origin` | TEXT | `local`, `remote` or `migration`. |

Index: `idx_docs_collection_updatedAt (collection, updatedAt)`.

The in-memory projection of a row is `DocumentRecord<T>`: `{ collection, id, rev, data, blobs, updatedAt }`, where `blobs` is a `BlobMap` of rehydrated typed arrays (filled by `getDoc`, empty for `queryDocs`).

## 3. Events (Write Model)

LiveStore synced events (namespace `livestruct.v1.`), all carrying `collection`, `id`, `mutationId`, `origin`, `updatedAt`:

| Event | Extra fields | Materializer |
|---|---|---|
| `DocInserted` | `data`, `blobs?`, `overlayId?` | `INSERT ... rev = 1 ... ON CONFLICT (key) DO NOTHING` |
| `DocReplaced` | `data`, `blobs?`, `overlayId?` | upsert; on conflict replace `body`, `rev = rev + 1` |
| `DocPatched` | `patch`, `blobs?`, `overlayId?` | `body = json_patch(body, ?)`, `rev = rev + 1` |
| `DocPathSet` | `path`, `value`, `overlayId?` | `body = json_set(body, ?, json(?))`, `rev = rev + 1` |
| `DocDeleted` | - | `DELETE FROM docs WHERE key = ?` |

`data`, `patch`, `value` and `blobs` are JSON strings; binary payloads never appear in events (only hashes).

Application-level writes map to events as follows:

| API | Event(s) |
|---|---|
| `collection.create`, `engine.insertDoc`, `commitRaw({ type: 'insert' })` | `DocInserted` |
| `doc.replace`, `engine.updateDoc`, `commitRaw({ type: 'update' })` | `DocReplaced` |
| `doc.patch` (via scheduler), `engine.patchDoc`, `commitRaw({ type: 'patch' })` | `DocPatched` |
| `doc.patchPath` (via scheduler), `engine.setPathDoc` | `DocPathSet` |
| `collection.delete`, `engine.deleteDoc`, `commitRaw({ type: 'delete' })` | `DocDeleted` |
| legacy v1 migration | `DocInserted` with `origin: 'migration'` |

## 4. Document State Model

A `LiveDocument` combines three layers into the visible `data`:

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Committed: loaded / created
    Committed --> Pending: patch / patchPath
    Pending --> Pending: more patches (coalesced)
    Pending --> Committed: commit succeeded
    Pending --> Committed: commit failed (rollback, errors$)
    Committed --> Tentative: remote overlay received
    Tentative --> Committed: matching commit / commit message / TTL expired
    Tentative --> Pending: local patch (local edits win)
    Committed --> [*]: deleted (local or remote) / dispose
```

| State | `isPending` | `isTentative` | `data` |
|---|---|---|---|
| Committed | `false` | `false` | committed body |
| Pending | `true` | `false` | committed body + local pending patches |
| Tentative | `false` | `true` | committed body + remote overlay patch |

## 5. Change Data Capture Contract

`CDCEvent<T>` (`src/engine/types.ts`):

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `type` | `insert`, `update` or `delete`. |
| `kind` | Adds `replace` for full-body replacement. |
| `collection`, `id` | Target document. |
| `rev` | Revision after the change. |
| `delta` | Patch (local patch) or full body (inserts, replaces, remote updates). |
| `data` | Full body after the change (absent for deletes). |
| `timestamp` | Milliseconds. |
| `mutationId`, `overlayId` | Correlation ids for echo suppression and overlay matching. |
| `origin` | `local`, `remote` or `migration`. |

`LiveEngineAccess<T>.cdc$` (the per-collection view used by `doc.engine`) carries `type`, `id`, `delta`, and `mutationId` / `overlayId` when present.

## 6. Diagnostic Events

`LiveStructEvent` (`src/document/types.ts`): `type` (`local_patch`, `overlay_sent`, `overlay_received`, `commit`, `remote_commit`), `collection`, `id`, `timestamp`, optional `rev`, `overlayId`, `senderSessionId`, `origin`, `patch`.

## 7. Ephemeral Messages

`OverlayChannel` messages on `BroadcastChannel` `livestruct:<storeId>:overlay`:

- `OverlayMessage` - `{ type: 'overlay', collection, id, patch, overlayId, senderSessionId, timestamp }`.
- `CommitMessage` - `{ type: 'commit', collection, id, overlayId, patch?, rev?, senderSessionId, timestamp }`.

They are never persisted.

## 8. Value Constraints

Document bodies must be JSON-safe (`assertJsonSafe`): no `NaN` / `Infinity`, functions, symbols, bigints, `Date`, `Map`, `Set`, typed arrays, `ArrayBuffer`, class instances or circular references. Violations throw `LiveStructValueError` with the offending `path`.
